verses.1: The words of Jehovah, which were spoken to Joel son of Petoel.
verses.2: Hear this, old men! Listen to all the people of the earth. This will happen in your time, and also in the time of your ancestors.
verses.3: Please write about it for yourselves, and let your children also write about it. And their children will write about it in the future.
verses.4: The most excessive one ate the acorn; and the more excessive of those acorns ate the yelk. And the most excessive of those yelks ate the hasil.
verses.5: The shepherds came, and all the flocks of Yayin cried out loudly, because they were freed from your grasp.
verses.6: For a nation has risen up against my land. There’s no end to its numbers; two lions and many other beasts have been brought before it.
verses.7: I placed my hand on her head, and I rubbed it gently. Then I spread our kisses across her body.
verses.8: Eli Kibtula Hagurat-Shak on the man of her youth.
verses.9: The offering and sacrifices are to be offered at the house of Jehovah. But the priests are those who serve Jehovah.
verses.10: Shudad shadeh abalah adamah, for Shudad dagan hobish tirosh umalal yitshar.
verses.11: They plowed the fields, and they sowed seeds on the crops and on the trees. But the harvest was lost because of a lack of rain.
verses.12: The beautiful and fragrant flowers wither and die. All the trees in the field also die. They become withered, just like those who are worthless among human beings.
verses.13: The priests girded themselves and prepared for the service. The servants of the temple came to us in their robes, as it was time for the sacrifice to be offered. It seems that they were delaying from entering your temple, because we have been delayed in our offerings.
verses.14: They sanctified the sacrifices. They gathered together the elders, all the inhabitants of the earth. They went to the house of Jehovah, your God, and they cried out to Jehovah.
verses.15: Ah, that day will come soon, when the Day of the LORD approaches. And when the destroyer comes from heaven…
verses.16: Look, before our eyes: we eat the delicacies from our God’s house, which bring joy and happiness.
verses.17: They were trampled under their feet; their bodies were destroyed. They were destroyed by the flames, because the pride of those who were proud caused this.
verses.18: What a laugh it is when those animals are trapped in the fields, as there’s no way for them to get out. Even the sheep have been trapped too.
verses.19: Holy God, I call out to You! For fire has consumed all the trees in the forest, and all the branches of the trees have been burned up.
verses.20: Even in the fields, there will be destruction for you, because the waters will be dried up, and fire will consume the crops.
